items.title: Thousands of mourners gather in Belgrade for war criminal Mladic's funeral
items.description: Thousands of mourners on Monday gathered at a church in Belgrade to view the body of Ratko Mladic, who died in The Hague, Netherlands, on August 27 while serving a life sentence for genocide, war crimes and crimes against humanity. items.description: Israeli air strike on residential building in Kfar Reman kills nine people, and two medics killed in drone attack.

items.title: US envoys Witkoff and Kushner hold Ukraine talks after meeting Putin
items.description: US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner held talks with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Kyiv, seeking to revive efforts to end the war. But the latest diplomatic push seems to have produced no breakthrough.

items.title: Peace talks rich in symbolism but fundamental differences between Russia and Ukraine remain
items.description: Despite talks between US envoys and both Putin and Zelensky, the expectation in Kyiv is the fighting will continue, writes James Landale.

items.title: Russia’s Lavrov Calls Accusations of Moscow’s Involvement in Leipzig Drone Incident ‘Start of Real War'
items.description: The German government said last week that Russia was responsible for an attempted drone attack at Leipzig/Halle Airport.

items.description: Sasha and Olga Kurovska are two Ukrainian sisters, one lives in Kyiv, the other in Paris. items.description: A US delegation led by Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner included Gene Lange, acting head of the US Treasury’s sanctions unit, signaling that sanctions policy was part of diplomatic talks in Moscow. items.title: Putin meets with US envoys for renewed talks on ending the war in Ukraine
items.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin met with U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner to try to revive a push to end the Russia-Ukraine war.

items.title: US Envoys Conclude Moscow Meeting With Putin As Kremlin Cites 'Difficult Situation'
items.description: US special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner have begun their meeting in Moscow with President Vladimir Putin as part of a renewed White House effort to end Russia's war against Ukraine, with the pair set to visit Kyiv afterward.

items.title: How the U.S. focus on Iran is fueling a more aggressive Putin
items.description: Trump's top envoys head to Moscow and Kyiv as Putin steps up round the clock bombing of Ukraine. With the U.S. distracted by Iran, is Putin becoming increasingly emboldened?

items.title: Repeated attacks on humanitarian warehouses put vital medical aid at risk in Ukraine: WHO
items.description: A new airstrike overnight damaged one of the main warehouses used by the World Health Organization (WHO) in Ukraine to store humanitarian medical supplies in the Kyiv region, the UN agency said on Friday.
